units.source_text: 尚侍玉鬘于黎明时分告辞。

en.t: Tamaki, the Naishi no Kami, took her leave at dawn.

units.source_text: 源氏赐赠礼品，对她说道：“我已似将与世长遗，悠悠日复一日，不知老之将至。

en.t: Genji gave her parting gifts and said, "I have been passing the days as though already left behind by the world, unaware that old age was drawing near.

units.source_text: 汝今特来祝寿，使我猛忆年华，不胜凄凉之感。

en.t: Now that you have come especially to celebrate my longevity, I am sharply reminded of the years that have passed, and I cannot help feeling desolate.

units.source_text: 今后务望时时来此，察看我年年衰老多少。

en.t: From now on, I hope you will come here from time to time and see how much I grow weaker with each year.

units.source_text: 我身为陈规所羁，行动不便，未能随意前来面晤，实甚遗憾。”

en.t: Bound as I am by old conventions, it is difficult for me to move about, and I deeply regret that I cannot come to see you whenever I wish."

units.source_text: 玉鬘此行，使源氏回忆往事，不免又喜又悲。

en.t: Tamaki's visit made Genji remember the past, and he could not help feeling both joy and sorrow.

units.source_text: 而匆匆一叙，立即辞去，又使他不能餍足，深为惋惜。

en.t: But because they had spoken only briefly before she at once took her leave, he was left unsatisfied and deeply regretful.

units.source_text: 亲父太政大臣对她只有血统之缘，而义父源氏对她的慈爱如此深厚周至，

en.t: Her real father, the Grand Minister, was connected to her only by blood, while her foster father Genji showed her such deep and attentive affection,

units.source_text: 今后日月绵长，身世永固，心中不胜感激。

en.t: and as she thought that the days ahead would stretch on and her place in life would remain secure, her heart overflowed with gratitude.
